refused_program.intent: Resolve a merge conflict in the dependency lock file by taking upstream's version as the base and re-adding the lines the local side added, then commit the merge.

postconditions.description: HEAD is a merge commit with two parents
postconditions.name: merge_committed

postconditions.description: no conflicted paths remain in the index
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_paths

postconditions.description: none of the files changed on both sides still contain conflict markers
postconditions.name: no_conflict_markers
postconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2) &&
comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD^1 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD^2 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) |
while IFS= read -r f; do
  if grep -I -q -E '^(<<<<<<< |=======$|>>>>>>> )' "$f"; then
    exit 1
  fi
done

postconditions.description: every line the local side added to a file both sides changed is present in the result
postconditions.name: local_additions_preserved
postconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2) &&
comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD^1 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD^2 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) |
while IFS= read -r f; do
  awk -v first="$f" 'FILENAME==first { seen[$0]=1; next } { if (!($0 in seen)) bad=1 } END { exit (bad+0) }' \
    "$f" \
    <(git diff --unified=0 --no-color "$base" HEAD^1 -- "$f" | awk '/^@@/ { if (h && !m) for (i=1;i<=n;i++) print a[i]; h=1; m=0; n=0; next } h && /^-/ { m=1; next } h && /^\+/ { a[++n]=substr($0,2) } END { if (h && !m) for (i=1;i<=n;i++) print a[i] }') ||
  exit 1
done

preconditions.description: the local branch and the upstream branch have each moved since their merge base
preconditions.name: branches_diverged

preconditions.description: both sides changed at least one common file since the merge base
preconditions.name: shared_file_changed
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) &&
comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) |
grep -q .

preconditions.description: the tracked worktree is clean or a merge is already in progress
preconditions.name: worktree_ready
